source: Bengio et al. framed learned continuous word representations as a way to fight the curse of dimensionality in language modeling: training examples can influence predictions for nearby representations rather than only exact discrete sequences. Later word-vector methods such as word2vec and GloVe made large-scale learning of useful geometric structure much cheaper. [1–3]
zh: 本吉奥等人。框架学习的连续单词表示作为对抗语言建模中维数灾难的一种方法：训练示例可以影响对附近表示的预测，而不仅仅是精确的离散序列。后来的词向量方法，例如 word2vec 和 GloVe，使得大规模学习有用的几何结构变得更加便宜。 [1–3]
